prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Interactions Practice Screen: Add an interactive practice screen after home intro where users practice dragging and summoning their pet on desktop.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_desktop_practice"], "new_desktop_practice": {"headline": "Practice Desktop Controls", "body": "Try dragging your pet around your desktop or right-clicking to access shortcuts.", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or toggle your pet.", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Got It, Finish!", "action": "next"}]}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight Story Narrative Redesign: Redesign the story introduction screen using a spotlight layout to prominently showcase the core desktop pet experience.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Choose a companion that lives right on your desktop, keeps you company, and brightens your workday."}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Accessory Selection Flow: Insert an accessory selection screen before photo upload so users choose a starter collar or bow for their pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_accessory_pick", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_accessory_pick": {"headline": "Choose Your Pet's First Accessory", "body": "Pick a starting accessory to style your new companion before finalizing adoption.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Starter Accessory", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Continue", "action": "next"}]}}
3: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Layout Pick Friend Redesign: Redesign the pick friend screen to a carousel layout with live companion previews.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Pick Your Pet Companion", "body": "Browse through available pets and pick the companion that best matches your desk setup.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mascot_default", "style": "playful"}]}}
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Startup Sound Tips on Waiting Screen: Display explicit desktop taskbar location hints on the waiting screen while background setup completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Your pet will appear near your taskbar once assets finish loading. Keep the app running!", "show_time_estimate": true}}
5: [finish, copy] Home Introduction Control Key Headline Update: Update the headline and body copy on home intro to explicitly mention primary shortcut keys for pet controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Active! Press Ctrl+Shift+P to Open Menu", "body": "Click on your desktop pet to interact, or use Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to adjust settings, talk, or hide your companion."}}
6: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Setup Duration Hint: Add a informative hint text on the path selection screen emphasizing that setup takes under one minute.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Quick path takes under 60 seconds. Custom path allows full pet personality setup."}}
7: [home, new_screen] Pet Voice Sound Diagnostic Screen: Add a pet sound test step before waiting screen to ensure system audio and desktop notifications work.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_sound_diagnostic", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_sound_diagnostic": {"headline": "Test Pet Audio & Desktop Alerts", "body": "Play a sample chirp to confirm your desktop audio and notifications are active.", "components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:pet_chirp", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Play Sample", "action": "play"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Looks Good", "action": "next"}]}}
8: [finish, incentive] Onboarding Completion Pet Badge Incentive: Add a prominent unlock badge component to the home intro screen celebrating onboarding completion.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Founder Companion Badge Unlocked!", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [adoption, layout] Split Layout Adoption Certificate Redesign: Change the adoption certificate screen layout to split view showcasing the pet rendering alongside certificate details.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your companion is officially registered to your desktop! Click below to complete registration."}}

verdicts.reason: Valid addition of post-onboarding practice screen after home intro.
Story redesign retains the job of introducing the desktop pet.
Valid addition of accessory selection sub-flow within onboarding.
Carousel redesign retains the job of letting the user choose a pet.
Updating waiting screen hint information is allowed within onboarding.
Updating home intro copy to explain controls is allowed.
Adding a duration hint retains both adopting and custom path options.
Valid addition of diagnostic screen within onboarding sub-flow.
Onboarding copy mentions free extras or gifts (unlocked badge).
Adoption certificate redesign fails to include the required official stamp.
